result_summary.title: High latency and slow load times on mobile app interface
result_summary.description: Our production mobile application, which uses the Cohort Builder for user segmentation displays, is experiencing severe performance degradation. Users in the US-East region are reporting that the app takes 10-15 seconds to load cohort-specific views, whereas it used to be under 2 seconds. We have confirmed this is affecting approximately 243 active users and is causing significant complaints. The backend metrics show normal CPU usage, but the API responses from the Cohort Builder seem delayed. Please investigate the query performance or caching mechanisms.
